content.text:
The grey descriptive text on the home page is now `#3d4650`. I added the rule at the end of `site/css/pages.css`, scoped to `.page-home`, so no other page changes. I loaded the page in a browser and confirmed the computed colour is `rgb(61, 70, 80)`, which is `#3d4650`.

It covers these elements:
- the hero lede
- the paragraphs inside cards (featured product and the "Why Acme" perks)
- the stat labels
- the newsletter note

I left the footer text and footer links alone because they aren't under headings. If you want those darkened too, say so.

All 12 visual tests pass, including home at desktop and phone size. The new colour is close enough to the old `#59636e` that the screenshot comparison's default tolerance doesn't flag it. I didn't update the approved screenshots, so you may want to regenerate the home ones.

STATUS: DONE
